channel.title: LA Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from LA Daily News (dailynews.com)

item.title: Crude oil prices surpass $100 a barrel as the Iran war impedes production and shipping
item.description: The increases followed the U.S. crude price jumping by 36% and Brent crude rising by 28% last week. Oil prices have surged as the war, now in its second week, ensnared countries and places that are critical to the production and movement of oil and gas from the Persian Gulf.

item.title: A son of Iran’s late supreme leader is chosen to replace his father as war rages
item.description: A secretive figure within the Islamic Republic, Mojtaba Khamenei was not seen publicly in the days after an Israeli airstrike targeting the supreme leader’s offices killed his 86-year-old father at the start of the war.

item.title: Rams free agency primer: Needs to address after Trent McDuffie, Kam Curl moves
item.description: After a major upgrade with the trade for All-Pro cornerback Trent McDuffie, here’s a look at what they are likely to address in the next few weeks when they can begin talking to free agents.

item.title: Forced Entry first, Super Corredora last at Santa Anita
item.description: Bob Baffert trains his sixth straight Santa Ysabel Stakes winner, taking advantage of the Breeders' Cup Juvenile Fillies champion's latest poor performance.

item.title: Woman arrested on suspicion of shooting at Rihanna’s home near Beverly Hills; no injuries reported
Alexander: Was Lakers’ victory over Knicks a statement?
item.description: They showed grit, and a willingness to take one for the team, in vanquishing one of the Eastern Conference’s better teams, 110-97, on Sunday afternoon.

item.title: Chargers agree to terms with former Dolphins fullback Alec Ingold on multiyear contract
item.description: The deal is reportedly for two years and worth up to $7.5 million. Ingold played the last four seasons with the Dolphins.

item.title: Councilwoman Nithya Raman formally launches her campaign for LA mayor
item.description: Raman made the announcement during an event at the Van Nuys/Sherman Oaks Recreation Center, where supporters gathered for a campaign kickoff before volunteers headed into nearby neighborhoods for door-to-door outreach.

item.title: Trent McDuffie reportedly agrees to extension with Rams to become NFL’s highest-paid CB
item.description: Multiple reports say the deal is a four-year, $124 million extension with $100 million guaranteed, days after they reportedly acquired McDuffie from the Kansas City Chiefs for a package of draft picks.

item.title: Ducks close homestand with flat finish against Blues
item.description: The Ducks collect 14 of a possible 18 points during a nine-game homestand before it ends with a 4-0 loss to the Blues, their fourth shutout defeat of the season.
